message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))**2)","C_expression":"0","derivation":"Retain the source-reconstructed body B(r)=-1/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))^2), C=0. The draft calculation confirms exact operation: every row with |r|<=1/4 and u=0 achieves a full residual at machine-epsilon level (<=2e-71), down from ~6.1e-5 under the linear reference. Specifically, g = r/2 + chi_r*chi_u*r^2*B(r) = r/2 - r^2/(2*(1+sqrt(1+r))^2) = r/(1+sqrt(1+r)) = sqrt(1+r)-1, the exact fixed-amplitude root, so E = (2g+g^2-r) + 2*u*g = 0 when u=0. The r=-1.0 row (LEFT:s=0:x=1/8) lies outside chi_r support (|r|>1/2) and correctly receives only the linear step r/2=-0.5, residual 0.25 unchanged. The r=-0.25 boundary row receives the full correction (chi_r=1 at |r|=rho_1) and achieves zero residual. The expression is C-infinity on r>-1, an open neighborhood of the closed outer rectangle |r|<=1/2. C=0 is retained because all observed state has u=0; the u*r*C coupling coefficient has no validated value and introducing an untested arm could degrade the whole residual at successor stages.","inspect":[],"note":"Successor should verify: (1) at stage p2 where tau^3 corrections may drive u away from zero, check whether the 2*u*g coupling term in E becomes significant relative to the already-cancelled r^2/4 remainder; (2) the LEFT:s=0:x=1/8 row with r=-1.0 remains outside all correction support by design (|r|>1/2) and should not be 'fixed' by widening the rectangle; (3) the source formula f(r)=r/2 - chi(r)*r^2/(2(1+sqrt(1+r))^2) from MATH_SOURCES/03_R3_EXACT_QUOTIENT.md section 1 is the canonical reference for this body; (4) no analytic-domain certificate is attached, but the expression is manifestly smooth on r>-1; (5) do not interpret machine-zero residuals on the finite test grid as a uniform bound over all admissible (r,u) or as a full PDE estimate."}
